question.html:
A square conducting loop of side length and total resistance moves with a constant velocity into a region of uniform magnetic field , as shown in the diagram. The magnetic field region has a total horizontal width .

a

Calculate the maximum magnetic flux through the loop when it is completely inside the magnetic field.

[1]

b

Determine the magnitude of the induced electromotive force (emf) in the loop as its leading edge enters the magnetic field.

[1]

c

Calculate the magnitude of the external force required to keep the loop moving at a constant velocity while it is entering the magnetic field.

[2]

d

Sketch a graph showing the variation of the induced current with time from the moment the leading edge enters the field until the trailing edge leaves the field. Clearly label the time values on the axis.

[2]

e

Explain, with reference to Lenz’s law and conservation of energy, why an external force is necessary to maintain the constant speed of the loop as it enters the magnetic field.

[3]
